sources.title: The FedNow Service: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.note: Explains the Federal Reserve's instant payment service and general features of instant payments. Used for background on payment timing and settlement; it does not describe a fictional transaction.

sources.title: Your Insured Deposits
sources.note: Describes deposit insurance coverage and account ownership categories in the United States. Coverage depends on the depositor, bank and account category.

sources.title: Credit reports and scores
sources.note: Introduces U.S. credit reports, scores and consumer rights. Details and available remedies depend on a person's circumstances.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63B: Authentication and Authenticator Management
sources.note: Provides technical guidance for digital authentication and authenticators. It is a standards reference, not a claim about any particular service's security.

sources.title: A Consumer's Guide to Insurance
sources.note: Offers general consumer information about insurance. Policy wording and state rules determine actual coverage and claims outcomes.

sources.title: Laws of the Game
sources.note: The International Football Association Board publishes the Laws of Association Football, including match duration and allowance for time lost. Rules can differ across sports and competitions.
